episode_row: O(n^2) dead code in the bullpen block slowed worker predictions (with E16)

commits.subject: fix(fly): remove O(n²) dead code + vectorize barrel for 10x faster predictions
commits.body:
The probable_pitcher_lookup code had an O(n²) df.loc scan inside
a .map() lambda (scanning 1.5M rows per game_pk). This was dead code —
the vectorized replacement on the next lines overwrote the result —
but it still ran, causing 30+ minute predictions on the Fly 2-vCPU VM.

Also vectorizes barrel classification (numpy instead of apply(axis=1))
and total_break computation (list comprehension instead of apply(axis=1)).

Additional fixes:
- fly.toml: increase health check grace period 2m → 15m (model training
  saturates CPU, making dashboard temporarily unresponsive)
- sync.py: include mdp_policy.npz in R2 sync (was missing, causing
  strategy to fall back to heuristic on Fly)
